methodology_sources: Exact source SceneSpec and scene_renderer.py primitive size2/scale semantics
groundtruth: Exact union boundary of axis-aligned boxes; split at every box min/max coordinate, occupied cell midpoint classification, only occupied-to-empty neighbor faces. Shared and internal primitive faces excluded. This is a reference for these primitive scenes, not a generic boolean or reconstruction product feature.

coordinate_evidence.raw: wrapper extract_mesh→mesh.export, no to_gradio_3d_orientation; GLB node transforms absent/identity
coordinate_evidence.upstream: get_spherical_cameras describes x back/y right/z up
coordinate_evidence.unknown: Input-camera-to-learned-canonical-pose calibration was not stored; no original input pose recovery claim.

normalization.rule: Each shape independently subtracts AABB midpoint and divides by its largest AABB extent, exactly once before registration. Groundtruth camera transformed by reference normalization only.
limits: Maximum AABB side is not rotation invariant; residual scale/pose dependence remains.
Physical output scale is not evaluated. No scale adjustment after seeing results.
No nonuniform scale, reflection, nonrigid deformation, decimation or mesh repair.

registration.initial_rotations: 24 signed permutation 3x3 matrices with determinant+1; permutations lexicographic, signs lexicographic (-1,+1). No data-driven extra starts.
registration.selection: Minimum bidirectional mean-squared nearest sampled-point distance on fit samples; ties by candidate index. Save all candidate transforms and scores.
registration.global_transform: One resulting proper rigid transform after fixed uniform normalization, reused in every view and holdout evaluation. No per-view correction.
registration.limit: Best of24 local ICP starts with access to full reference shape is an optimistic diagnostic, not proven global optimum, not learned pose recovery or production inference.

evaluation.definition: CD_mean_sq = mean min squared Euclidean distance(P→G) + mean min squared Euclidean distance(G→P); per-direction mean distance/RMS/p95 also reported.
evaluation.units: Reference largest-AABB-side normalized length; squared metrics squared normalized units. Each-condition points retain that frame.
limits: Mean-normalized metric differs from original CVPR2017 sum definition.
Finite sampled-point distance is not exact point-to-surface distance; independent-seed same-reference floor is reported.
Single input hidden geometry is ambiguous; these two synthetic shapes do not represent a real-user quality distribution.

views.camera_target: Original SceneSpec camera target; exact source camera plus front -Y, right +X, rear +Y, left -X at original horizontal radius/elevation/distance. All shapes/conditions use identical reference cameras.
views.renderer: Pillow opaque projected triangle union silhouette, no per-face backface culling, no shading/material/texture/depth quality claim. All vertices must be in front of near plane; framing/clipping diagnostics preserved.
views.metric: Intersection over union of binary silhouette pixel masks; no acceptance threshold or user preference claim.

controls: Duplicate coincident unit cubes union:area6 volume1; overlapping unit cubes shifted0.5X:area8 volume1.5; exact vertices/occupancy/bounds recorded.
Same pointcloud distance exactly0; same silhouette IoU1.
Independent surface samples of same reference report nonzero finite-sampling floor.
Known proper rigid+uniform scale transform through the same AABB normalization and registration reports remaining errors rather than assuming invariance.
Synthetic chair with backrest removed in unchanged reference frame is a negative diagnostic, not AI output.

safety.environment: Explicit whitelist, no credentials or .env; Python bytecode disabled; numerical threads capped2

scope_limits: No raw commercial Tripo result for the same input, so commercial/open parity remains unproven.
No new model inference or repeat of prior platform import/render or S819 color checks.
Software silhouette diagnostics are not a platform UI/render/end-to-end or performance acceptance.
No unseen-view fidelity conclusion from input-only correspondence.
